title: Kylee's Vanilla Pack
description:
A simple modpack made with mods to reduce the amount of boring parts of minecraft, and to improve the immersive parts.
This modpack is excellent at improving the gameplay experience.
body:
This is a modpack designed to be as close to vanilla as possible with a few quality of life mods added in, such as "Apple Skin" or "Inventory Sorting" to reduce menial amounts of gameplay to keep the player focused more on larger tasks or to remove annoying issues like the "Lightly" mod to help light your base and caves.
This modpack also includes immersive mods such as "Immersive Thunder", "Cool Rain". and "Partical Rain" to improve the overal experience you get from the game.
